recs.title: Neural Isomorphic Fields: A Transformer-based Algebraic Numerical Embedding
recs.venue: arXiv.org
recs.summary: This paper introduces a fixed-length number embedding vector that preserves algebraic operations, including addition, multiplication, and comparison, within the field of rational numbers, and proposes a novel Neural Isomorphic Field, a neural abstraction of algebraic structures such as groups and fields.

recs.summary: It is shown that LLM accuracy drops substantially when numerical inputs are rendered in underrepresented scripts or formats, despite the underlying mathematical reasoning being identical, and that targeted prompting strategies can greatly narrow this gap.

recs.title: Generalizing Numerical Reasoning in Table Data through Operation Sketches and Self-Supervised Learning
recs.venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
recs.summary: TaNOS is introduced, a continual pretraining framework comprising three components: header anonymization to reduce lexical memorization, operation sketches that provide minimal structural cues, and self-supervised pretraining that constructs correctness-guaranteed program–question pairs from given tables in a program-first manner that improves the transferability of numerical reasoning.

recs.title: Measurement Extraction with Natural Language Processing: A Review
recs.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: In this review, an overview of prior work on measurement extraction is presented and different approaches to measurement extraction are described and the challenges posed by this task are outlined.

recs.title: Methods for Numeracy-Preserving Word Embeddings
recs.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: DICE outperforms a wide range of pre-trained word embedding models across multiple examples of two tasks: evaluating the ability to capture numeration and magnitude; and to perform list maximum, decoding, and addition.

recs.title: An Empirical Investigation of Contextualized Number Prediction
recs.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: A suite of output distribution parameterizations are introduced that incorporate latent variables to add expressivity and better fit the natural distribution of numeric values in running text, and combine them with both recur-rent and transformer-based encoder architectures.

recs.title: Reasoning about Quantities in Natural Language
recs.venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
recs.summary: A computational approach is developed which is shown to successfully recognize and normalize textual expressions of quantities and is used to further develop algorithms to assist reasoning in the context of the aforementioned tasks.

recs.title: KitchenScale: Learning to predict ingredient quantities from recipe contexts
recs.venue: Expert systems with applications
recs.summary: This work introduces KitchenScale, a fine-tuned Pre- trained Pre-trained Language Model (PLM) that predicts a target ingredient's quantity and measurement unit given its recipe context and adopted the Discrete Latent Exponent method to cope with high variance of numerical scales in recipe corpora.

recs.title: Deep Neural Solver for Math Word Problems
recs.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: Experiments conducted on a large dataset show that the RNN model and the hybrid model significantly outperform state-of-the-art statistical learning methods for math word problem solving.

recs.title: Dense Retrieval with Quantity Comparison Intent
recs.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics

recs.title: Introducing Semantic Information for Numerical Attribute Prediction over Knowledge Graphs
recs.venue: International Workshop on the Semantic Web
recs.summary: This paper re-examines the numerical attribute prediction task over KGs, and introduces several novel methods to explore and utilize the rich semantic knowledge of language models (LMs) for this task.

recs.title: Do Numbers Matter? Types and Prevalence of Numbers in Clinical Texts
recs.venue: Workshop on Biomedical Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: The need for a public benchmark that will support investigation of numerical processing tasks for the clinical domain and a taxonomy of number variants are identified.

recs.title: How well do Computers Solve Math Word Problems? Large-Scale Dataset Construction and Evaluation
recs.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
recs.summary: A large-scale dataset is built which is more than 9 times the size of previous ones, and contains many more problem types, and semi-automatically obtained from community question-answering web pages.

recs.title: NumNet: Machine Reading Comprehension with Numerical Reasoning
recs.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: A numerical MRC model named as NumNet is proposed, which utilizes a numerically-aware graph neural network to consider the comparing information and performs numerical reasoning over numbers in the question and passage, outperforming all existing machine reading comprehension models by considering the numerical relations among numbers.

recs.title: A Primer for Neural Arithmetic Logic Modules
recs.venue: Journal of machine learning research
recs.summary: Focusing on the shortcomings of the NALU, an in-depth analysis is provided to reason about design choices of recent modules, and a benchmark is created which compares all existing arithmetic NALMs.

recs.title: A Causal Framework to Quantify the Robustness of Mathematical Reasoning with Language Models
recs.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
recs.summary: This work proposes a novel framework, which pins down the causal effect of various factors in the input, e.g., the surface form of the problem text, the operands, and math operators on the output solution, and applies this framework on a test bed of math word problems.

recs.title: Neural Arithmetic Logic Units
recs.venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
recs.summary: Experiments show that NALU-enhanced neural networks can learn to track time, perform arithmetic over images of numbers, translate numerical language into real-valued scalars, execute computer code, and count objects in images.

recs.title: Mathematical Language Models: A Survey
recs.venue: ACM Computing Surveys
recs.summary: A comprehensive survey of mathematical LMs is conducted, systematically categorizing pivotal research endeavors from two distinct perspectives: tasks and methodologies.

recs.title: Numerically Grounded Language Models for Semantic Error Correction
recs.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: Numerical grounding in language models grounded in numbers within the text improves perplexity and F1 for semantic error correction by 5 points when compared to ungrounded approaches and conditioning on a knowledge base yields further improvements.

recs.title: Numbers Matter! Bringing Quantity-awareness to Retrieval Systems
recs.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
recs.summary: This paper introduces two quantity-aware ranking techniques designed to rank both the quantity and textual content either jointly or independently and introduces two novel quantity-aware benchmark datasets in the domains of finance and medicine.

recs.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
recs.venue: North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics
recs.summary: A new language representation model, BERT, designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers, which can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks.

recs.title: Learning Non-linguistic Skills without Sacrificing Linguistic Proficiency
recs.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
recs.summary: This work takes a closer look into the phenomena of catastrophic forgetting as it pertains to LLMs and offers a novel framework for non-linguistic skill injection for LLMs based on information-theoretic interventions and skill-specific losses that enable the learning of strict arithmetic reasoning.

recs.title: Children's understanding of counting.
recs.venue: Cognition
recs.summary: Children learn the meanings of smaller number words before larger ones within their counting range, up to the number three or four, indicating that children learn the cardinal word principle at roughly 3 1/2 years of age.
